let cursor = 0;
const saved = [];
const reader = {
	async read() {
		return cursor < 3 ? ++cursor : null;
	},
};
async function main() {
	let item;
	while ((item = await reader.read()) !== null) {
		saved.push(item);
	}
	if (saved.join(",") !== "1,2,3") throw Error(String(saved));
	console.log(JSON.stringify({ saved }));
}
main();
